source_payments: Portal da Transparência da Prefeitura de São Borja
source_geography: RFB Dados Abertos CNPJ, competência 2026-08; bytes transported through mirror in this run
interpretation_rule: These are first-order territorial exposure indicators for rubric-compatible payments, not final leakage rates.
limitations: RFB bytes were obtained via a transport mirror because the official host timed out; results remain exploratory until official hash/reexecution reconciliation.
LOCAL_EXACT_NONACTIVE_SNAPSHOT is kept separate because a supplier may have received payment earlier in 2026 and become nonactive by the August 2026 RFB snapshot.
ROOT_WITH_LOCAL_ACTIVE_FOOTPRINT does not prove that the local establishment executed the contract.
External supplier does not imply 100% leakage; local supplier does not imply 100% retention.
The rubric-compatible core includes institutional service arrangements; the Fundação Ivan Goulart sensitivity isolates the dominant case.
